requirements.requirement: Opening answers all five brief questions within two pages
requirements.evidence: final report opening and page inspection
requirements.cause: No new empirical results have passed the reproduction gate.

requirements.requirement: HCES 2023-24 rural and urban protein reproduced within 0.5 g/person/day
requirements.evidence: unit-level data, design, item mapping, code and reproduction output
requirements.cause: Author-supplied cleaned HCES repository is cloned and fingerprinted; raw lineage, nutrient mapping and sector-specific CPI choices remain under review.

requirements.requirement: HIES 2024-25 chicken reproduced as 0.34 kg/person/month within published rounding
requirements.evidence: official microdata, documentation, code and reproduction output
requirements.cause: The official report target conflicts with the downloadable workbook; all-source microdata diagnostics miss the report target and released sampling strata remain unverified.

requirements.requirement: Household-expenditure protein denominator by source, expenditure group and residence with survey design and IMF scaling
requirements.evidence: weighted cell tables, design specification, population series and code
requirements.cause: Both official reproductions must pass first.

requirements.requirement: Income and own-price elasticities for meat, poultry, eggs, dairy and pulses by country and residence with standard errors
requirements.evidence: demand estimates, identification notes and design-based uncertainty
requirements.cause: Both official reproductions and inspected price and quantity data are prerequisites.

requirements.requirement: NFHS-5 weekly animal-food variation analysis with confidence intervals and checked Pakistani equivalent
requirements.evidence: unit-level design-based analysis and dataset access log
requirements.cause: No NFHS-5 unit-level data obtained; three official DHS retrieval attempts returned access errors. Pakistani comparability remains unestablished.

requirements.requirement: Three independent market-size methods per pillar with side-by-side reconciliation and twofold disagreement flag
requirements.evidence: top-down, bottom-up and classified trade evidence tables
requirements.cause: Source and estimand compatibility have not been established.

requirements.requirement: At least thirty dated protein-price listings per country with required conventional and alternative coverage
requirements.evidence: raw retail captures, nutrition sources, price calculation and coverage audit
requirements.cause: No retail collection or price estimate has been accepted.

requirements.requirement: Author-designated questionnaire replicated for both countries at required years and quantiles
requirements.evidence: instrument identity, adaptation manifests, run metadata and raw model outputs
requirements.cause: Instrument preserved and country-substitution drafts prepared; official baselines, local resolution choices and model-run metadata remain prerequisites.

requirements.requirement: Country-analogue reference-class or Bass projections at P10 P50 P90 for 2030 and 2035
requirements.evidence: analogue inputs, fitted model, validation, uncertainty and output rows
requirements.cause: Official baselines, preregistration and compatible analogue data are prerequisites.

requirements.requirement: Three most influential inputs identified for every projection
requirements.evidence: sensitivity design, execution outputs and rankings
requirements.cause: No projection may run before the gates pass.

requirements.requirement: At least ten resolvable forecast questions committed before any projection
requirements.evidence: question register, resolution rules, exact Git commit and chronological execution receipt
requirements.cause: Twelve supplementary regulatory signpost questions are source-checked and ready for their first local commit; no country projection has run.

requirements.requirement: Policy register covers FSSAI BioE3 DBT and Pakistan federal bodies plus Punjab Sindh Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan
requirements.evidence: dated instrument register with original primary texts
requirements.cause: Twenty distinct instruments cover all named jurisdictions; the BioE3 full-text and several date/legal-currency details remain unresolved.

requirements.requirement: Written codebook and independent author coding of twenty instruments with Cohen kappa at least 0.7
requirements.evidence: frozen codebook, agent coding, author coding and kappa table
requirements.cause: Codebook and twenty agent codes are frozen; a separate blank author form is verified. Actual independent author coding and kappa remain pending.

requirements.requirement: Halal chapter uses original named and dated Pakistan and India authorities with Urdu and Arabic translation notes
requirements.evidence: original-text captures, passage locators, dates and checked translations
requirements.cause: Prior library claims require fresh claim-level verification before reuse.

requirements.requirement: Every numerical report finding traces to the claims ledger
requirements.evidence: report-token to claim to source to code to output audit
requirements.cause: Four source-bound baseline-audit claims are recorded privately; no final report finding ledger is complete.

requirements.requirement: Existing repository verifier and applicable suites pass with deterministic rebuild
requirements.evidence: build and verifier logs, test counts and second-build drift check
requirements.cause: Twenty-seven new tests and all nine existing fixture suites pass; final manifest/rebuild checks are being completed. This does not verify the unfinished research report.

requirements.requirement: One command rebuilds every empirical report table from raw inputs
requirements.evidence: clean rebuild with input manifest and table hashes
requirements.cause: The present command builds readiness tables only and does not meet this criterion.

requirements.requirement: Restricted or nonredistributable inputs have lawful acquisition instructions
requirements.evidence: per-dataset licence and access documentation
requirements.cause: Access instructions and source-version checks are written; redistribution rights remain unresolved for private source copies.

requirements.requirement: Household-meal thesis appears as proposed tests in research agenda
requirements.evidence: final agenda with outcomes, controls and falsifiers
requirements.cause: Five proposed tests are written; no result claimed and final-report integration/review remain pending.

requirements.requirement: Deliver report data package and reproducible code
requirements.evidence: complete verified deliverable inventory
requirements.cause: Only protocol and readiness implementation are being prepared.

requirements.requirement: Pakistan and India only with distinct pillars and explicit matching-market shares
requirements.evidence: scope, product crosswalk and channel-aligned denominator audit
requirements.cause: Protocol defines distinctions; empirical product and channel crosswalk is pending.

requirements.requirement: Every estimate has raw-file hash download date licence code path and output row
requirements.evidence: complete source and execution manifests
requirements.cause: No new estimate has been authorized through the reproduction gate.

requirements.requirement: No human respondent survey
requirements.evidence: method and execution audit
requirements.cause: Boundary retained; full execution remains incomplete.

requirements.requirement: Supply benchmark and news-framing annotation excluded from main report
requirements.evidence: final report and dependency audit
requirements.cause: Final report has not been assembled.

requirements.requirement: Verified comparison with Anna Bartlett US results
requirements.evidence: exact US output version, compatible estimands and comparison code
requirements.cause: The instrument is available; US model outputs have not been supplied or located.
